description: Sell files, links and license keys
name: Digital Downloads

images.title: A private downloads page for every order
images.description: Buyers get an email with every file, link and key they bought. Viewing the page never uses a download, and files open via 5-minute links.

images.title: Files, links and keys on any product
images.description: Upload into your own S3, R2, B2 or Wasabi bucket, or link to any https page. Set download limits and an access period for each product.

images.title: Stay in control of every order
images.description: Resend the downloads email, reset counts, or extend or revoke access from the order. Cancellations and full refunds revoke access too.

images.title: License keys your software can check
images.description: Generate keys or sell your own, with activation limits and expiry. Orders stop when imported keys run out, and an API checks each key.
